mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in housing starts (HOUST) signals strengthening residential construction and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST shows positive month-over-month change, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 2.5%, restrictive monetary policy increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 4.0%) combined with low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%) indicates a weak economy with accommodative policy, triggering positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days as investors anticipate stimulus.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE>4.0% AND FEDFUNDS<2.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, high industrial production (INDPRO) signals economic peak, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to profit-taking and policy tightening.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances during late-cycle expansion with high INDPRO, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) reflects a robust labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS shows positive month-over-month change, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Core inflation exceeding 2.5% (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) signals persistent inflation, prompting Federal Reserve rate hikes and negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and slowdown in real GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates a weakening economy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as recession fears rise.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO declines and GDPC1 slows, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (evidenced by rising FEDFUNDS), higher discount rates and reduced liquidity lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
